specs: Pirate-themed rafting with water cannon battles
Class I-III rapids on Lehigh River
Award-winning paintball fields with castles and villages

Youth and student groups require parent or guardian supervision on river
Water shoes, old sneakers, or sandals with ankle straps recommended; no flip-flops or bare feet

Most rafts accommodate 4 to 7 people; smaller groups may be teamed up with others

blurb: Guests participate in whitewater rafting trips on the Lehigh River, including family-style rafting with picnic lunch, dog-friendly rafting days, and multisport adventures combining rafting with biking and paintball. Trips feature Class I-III rapids and are guided by experienced staff. Additional activities include hiking and paintball at their facilities.
